caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of elements that resemble both a vintage mechanical device and an animal form. The central structure is made up of a brown, metallic-looking body with a funnel-like top and circular components, suggestive of an old-fashioned appliance or tool, such as a meat grinder. Emerging from the central body are six curved, jointed appendages that mimic the legs of an insect or arachnid, and they are also brown, matching the mechanical parts in material and color. The drawing is rendered in a realistic style, with detailed shading and texture work that emphasizes the metallic and slightly worn quality of the surfaces. The background is plain and off-white, providing no additional context or scenery. The artist’s name, "H. SCHULZE," appears in small letters in the lower left of the image.
title: Cherry Pitter
